title: End-of-term test results
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 2: Indices, fractions, percentages and standard form; number sense
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 53 (End-of-term test results (portal))
intro: Lesson 53: Test feedback and next steps. To understand my test results and correct my errors so the skills are secure for Year 9

questions.q: redo every question you dropped marks on, using the correction format; then complete the matching portal strengthen set (8 questions).
questions.a: Answers in the portal strengthen set; for example (4 × 10³)² = 1.6 × 10⁷, 18 out of 24 = 75%

questions.q: A price rises 25% and then falls 20%. Prove it returns to the original price.
Which is the correct method for '30% off gives £70'?

questions.a: For example: 'adjust standard form answers'; 'divide by the original in percentage change'.
